rationale: National social-science data archive with long back-series; standalone but access/legal terms unclear and only indirectly payments-relevant.
SiStat enterprise-statistics subject area; monitored via the parent SURS/SiStat portal but in-scope as merchant denominator.
Single DocSysFile methodology PDF — essential reference for break-in-series, not a continuously producing feed.
Statutory Banka Slovenije register of licensed payment institutions — core named population of Slovenian PSPs.
E-money institution register from the same regulator; url_verification failed is a soft signal only, likely a locale/path redirect.
EEA passporting list captures foreign PSPs invisible in national filings; failed check treated as soft, re-verify in browser pass.
Dated one-off notification PDF; useful longitudinal evidence but the register page is the monitorable parent.
AJPES ePRS business register search is the join key resolving PSP names to registration identifiers; mine on demand rather than poll.
AJPES publication-calendar sub-page; scheduling metadata for the annual-reports pull, no standalone signal stream.
Court/business register gazette is a continuous early-signal feed of new payments entities, capital and ownership changes.
Beneficial-ownership register materially restricted since Aug 2025; a human must clear lawful access before use.
Paid AJPES analytics layer over data already collected free; only worth it if a subscription is cleared.
Filing-obligation rules page under AJPES; static metadata that prevents false negatives, no independent monitoring value.
EBA EUCLID PIR gives standardised PSD2 service codes and an independent cross-check on the BS registers.
Bulk-downloadable EEA credit-institution register; the Slovenian bank population that owns most ATM/POS estates.
Expensive commercial aggregator largely redundant with AJPES; only after a paid-access decision.
BS reporting-framework page; defines which payment volume/value datapoints exist, covered by monitoring bsi.si.
Statutory national procurement portal — primary source of Slovenian ATM/POS/CIT tender and award notices.
e-JN live tender listing gives the earliest pipeline signal ahead of award publication; public listing needs no login.
Machine-readable OPSI procurement dataset from 2013 — best bulk quantitative entry point, no scraping needed.
Single OPSI resource file inside a dataset already covered; automatable feed of currently open tenders.
Published post-award contracts carry terminal/ATM counts, unit prices and SLA terms unavailable in notices.
STATIST analytics app over OPSI procurement data; fast vendor ranking and category sizing before deep extraction.
TED mirrors all above-threshold Slovenian notices in structured eForms with CPV codes and award values.
Documented authentication-free TED search API — the correct repeatable collection channel for SI procurement.
TED XML bulk/FTP archive enables decades-long reconstruction of ATM/POS/CIT contract cycles and incumbent rotation.
TED SPARQL open-data endpoint for custom cross-notice extraction; complements but overlaps the search API.
